notes: Rule 29 fronting: the rectum הַזָּהָב carries an article and the ASV renders it anarthrously ('of gold'), so the phrase's single 'the' is the article's, fronted to the left edge, and the construct מִשְׁקַל keeps only 'weight'. This matches 9.11 and 9.25 in the same chapter and the contract's לֻחֹת הָאֲבָנִים example.
